mainEntity.name: Is the Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi engine the same as the Peugeot 107 or Citroën C1 diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - the DV4-TD (2WZ-TV) 1.4 HDi diesel engine is shared across the Toyota Aygo, Peugeot 107/108 and Citroën C1. All three cars were built at the same TPCA joint venture factory in the Czech Republic. Engines are fully interchangeable between these models, which is important for sourcing used units.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used DV4-TD engine for your Aygo 1.4 HDi typically costs £695-£900, while a reconditioned unit ranges from £900-£1,200 and a fully rebuilt engine can cost £1,100-£1,500. Supply and fit adds approximately £400-£700 depending on your location and specialist.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical 2005-2010 Aygo 1.4 HDi is worth £800-£1,600. A rebuilt DV4-TD at £1,100-£1,500 is a significant investment, but if the rest of the vehicle is sound and has relatively low mileage, it can give you another 80,000+ miles of reliable service. For vehicles worth under £1,000, a used engine at £695 is usually the more sensible option.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical DV4-TD engine replacement takes 1-2 days for a specialist workshop, assuming no complications. Supply-only delivery is usually 2-5 working days depending on your location and the supplier's stock position.

mainEntity.name: What causes head gasket failure in a Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head gasket failure is most commonly caused by engine overheating - typically from coolant leaks, thermostat failure, or cooling fan issues. Symptoms include white smoke from the exhaust, coolant loss, rough idle, and oil in the coolant.

mainEntity.name: When should I replace the timing belt on my Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi?

acceptedAnswer.text: The DV4-TD is an interference engine - if the timing belt breaks, valves will bend. Replacement is recommended every 60,000 miles or 5 years, whichever comes first. A specialist timing belt replacement typically costs £250-£400 including tensioner and water pump.

historyTimeline.h2: Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi joined the first-generation Aygo lineup in 2005 as the fuel-efficiency option, powered by the PSA-developed DV4-TD diesel engine (also known as the 2WZ-TV). Produced until 2014, the 1.4 HDi offered exceptional fuel economy - up to 65.7 mpg - making it a popular choice for cost-conscious city car owners and high-mileage drivers.

milestones.description: DV4-TD (2WZ-TV) introduced with first-generation Aygo, 1.4-litre turbo-diesel I4, 54 hp (40 kW), 130 Nm torque
2007 - Early production run of the 2WZ-TV diesel engine
2009 - 1.4 D-4D available across first-generation Aygo range
2014 - 1.4 HDi continued with Euro 4 compliance; production of diesel Aygo continued until 2014
Diesel Aygo discontinued; second-generation Aygo (2014-2021) offered petrol only
Aygo X launched with 1KR-B52 petrol engine only - no diesel option

commonProblems.h2: Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi's DV4-TD engine is generally robust, but three issues can drive replacement decisions: timing belt failure (catastrophic on this interference engine), fuel system problems (PCV/VCV valve failure), and head gasket failure from overheating. Rebuilt DV4-TD engines through EnginesMarket include new timing components and fuel system servicing, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Belt Failure - Why the Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi DV4-TD Is an Interference Engine
problems.rootCause: The DV4-TD uses a timing belt rather than a chain. As an interference engine, piston-to-valve contact occurs if the belt breaks, bending valves and often destroying the cylinder head. Regular belt changes are critical - neglect leads to catastrophic engine failure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace timing belt, tensioner, water pump
repairOptions.longevity: Best if done every 60,000 miles - prevents catastrophic failure

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Remove head, replace bent valves, skim head
repairOptions.longevity: If belt has broken but block is undamaged

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt DV4-TD with new timing components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If belt failure has caused piston damage or engine has >120,000 miles

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 2005-2010 Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi is worth £800-£1,600. A full rebuilt engine at £1,100-£1,500 represents a significant proportion of the vehicle's value. For an Aygo 1.4 HDi worth under £1,000, a used engine at £695-£900 is often the most sensible option. However, if the vehicle is in good condition with low miles, the rebuilt route with warranty may still be worthwhile.
problems.recommendation: Replace the timing belt every 60,000 miles without fail - it's the single most important maintenance item on the DV4-TD. The £250-£400 specialist cost is far cheaper than a £1,100+ engine replacement. If the belt has already broken, carefully evaluate the vehicle's overall condition before committing to a rebuild.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt DV4-TD Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi engine prices

problems.h4: Fuel System Problems (PCV/VCV Valves) - Why the Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi DV4-TD Suffers Fuel Issues
problems.rootCause: The Siemens Common Rail fuel system on the DV4-TD is generally reliable but the PCV (pressure control valve) and VCV (volume control valve) in the high-pressure fuel pump are known weak points. Symptoms include rough running, loss of power, starting difficulties, and fault codes P0089 (pressure control valve plausibility).

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace faulty PCV or VCV valve in high-pressure fuel pump
repairOptions.longevity: Best if caught early - restores fuel pressure regulation

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Strip and rebuild high-pressure pump, replace valves and seals
repairOptions.longevity: If multiple valves failed or pump damaged

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt DV4-TD with fuel system serviced, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If fuel system issues have caused injector or cylinder damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: For an Aygo 1.4 HDi valued at £800-£1,600, valve replacement at £150-£300 is a sensible investment. If the vehicle has over 120,000 miles and multiple fuel system components are failing, a rebuilt engine may be the better long-term choice.
problems.recommendation: If you're experiencing rough running or starting issues on your Aygo 1.4 HDi, have the fuel system diagnosed promptly. Valve replacement is relatively inexpensive and can restore reliable operation. Don't ignore fuel system warning signs - they can lead to injector failure and more costly repairs.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt DV4-TD Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi engine prices

problems.h4: Head Gasket Failure - Why the Toyota Aygo 1.4 HDi DV4-TD Can Overheat
problems.rootCause: The DV4-TD can suffer head gasket failure if the engine overheats - typically from coolant leaks, thermostat failure, or cooling fan issues. Symptoms include white smoke from the exhaust, coolant loss, rough idle, and oil in the coolant.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace head gasket, skim head, pressure test
repairOptions.longevity: If caught early before block damage

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt DV4-TD with new gasket and cooling components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If head gasket failure has caused piston or cylinder damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: For an Aygo 1.4 HDi worth £800-£1,600, head gasket replacement at £600-£900 is a significant cost. If the vehicle has over 120,000 miles, consider whether a rebuilt engine or a used unit offers better value.
problems.recommendation: Monitor your coolant level regularly and address any overheating immediately. Shutting down as soon as you see the temperature gauge rise will usually prevent significant engine damage. If head gasket failure is confirmed on a high-mileage Aygo 1.4 HDi, compare the cost of repair against a replacement engine - you may find replacement is the more cost-effective option.
